character.description: Round-bellied Vietnamese fruit vendor uncle with woven straw hat, orange-blue checked shirt, teal apron, salt-and-pepper moustache, gold tooth and sandals.

chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 3 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: Four small front-facing idle beats with sandals planted: hands on hips, blink and moustache twitch, a proud playful wink, then return to the opening pose. Subtle breathing only; preserve scale and foot line.

work.action: A seamless four-frame fruit-selling loop, front-facing and planted: he holds the same ripe mango low in his right hand, polishes it once on the apron, lifts it to present toward the customer with a proud grin, then lowers it to the identical opening position. Keep the same mango, hand, outfit, body size and sandals; no scenery.

style: Hand-inked Vietnamese 2D mobile game sprite matching the supplied vendor base exactly. Bold dark-brown comic contour, slightly irregular hand-drawn line, readable simplified shapes, warm limited colors and restrained matte cel shading; no glossy 3D finish. Compact chibi proportions, humorous readable facial acting, stable full-body front view, same height, outfit, head shape and ground line in every frame. Single character on transparent background, no scenery, no labels or text.
